text:
Lena M: Quick check-in: partner asked for a lightweight marketplace "starter kit" that bundles our inference Terraform modules + a minimal sample app + packaging for their listing. Aim: pilot in 3 weeks.
Diego R: We should produce a reference layout that is deployable and testable by their engineers. Not just demos.
Ava S: They want both arm64 (Graviton/Ampere) and x86 flavors documented. Can we provide tfvars and a compatibility matrix?
Diego R: Yes. Plan: two tfvars files (vars.arm64.tfvars, vars.x86.tfvars) and a compatibility.md explaining recommended instance families and AMIs/container tags.
Lena M: Also need marketplace manifest + an example Helm chart for the sample app. Partner wants a single tarball they can ingest.
Diego R: I'll add a top-level /marketplace/manifest.yaml and a build script scripts/package_for_marketplace.sh that produces starterkit.tar.gz.
Ava S: Legal flagged third-party licenses and model license language. Please include LICENSE, NOTICE, and a short MODEL_LICENSE.md.
Diego R: Agreed. We'll add a small README_PARTNER.md that highlights model licensing and best-effort de-identification notes for logs.
Lena M: Can we include an opinionated inference config example for batching/latency tradeoffs? That helps the partner tune defaults.
Diego R: Add example config in samples/configs/batching.yaml, e.g.:
```
# samples/configs/batching.yaml
inference:
  max_batch_tokens: 1024
  max_batch_size: 24
  latency_target_ms: 100
  prioritize_latency: true
```
Ava S: Nice. Also include a short CI workflow that runs terraform fmt + plan against the module so partner can see hygiene.
Diego R: I'll add .github/workflows/ci.yml with a job: terraform init/plan --target=module.redwood_inference. Also add a smoke test that deploys to a temporary account (mocked) for QA.
partners-bot: Created ticket PARTNERS-8921: "Marketplace starter kit: Terraform modules + sample app" assigned to @Diego R  https://issues.redwood/8921 :ticket:
Lena M: Timeline: Diego: modules + tfvars (4 days), sample app + chart (4 days), docs + packaging + legal checks (3 days). That leaves a week for partner QA before pilot.
Diego R: I'll branch feat/marketplace-starterkit and push incremental commits. Will put a clear CHANGELOG.md with release notes.
Ava S: I'll prepare a 20-minute walkthrough deck and a small onboarding checklist for partner engineers.
Lena M: Security: John from infra asked that we include KMS hints for secrets and remove any debug keys from samples. I'll loop him in for a quick review before packaging.
Diego R: Noted. We'll add a playbook: starterkit/playbooks/upgrade-rollback.md with steps for safe rollouts and how to roll back module changes.
Lena M: Perfect. Once Diego creates the first packaging artifact, ping me and I'll schedule the workshop with partner. Thanks :raised_hands:
